label: AGog A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact original green reptilian gog monster: lean upright biped, small angular reptile head with short projecting muzzle, narrow yellow eyes, pale pointed teeth and small chin spike. Two long ivory-gray horns sweep outward and upward from the sides of the crown, with a thin pointed central crest. Large pointed green ear fins, textured emerald-green scales, muted mint highlights and deep near-black green shadows. Muscular shoulders, long bent arms, large open clawed hands with pale horn-colored nails, lean long legs and three large splayed clawed toes. Thin long green tail with pointed dark spade tip curls behind the legs; preserve its exact native curve and the rear ankle spur. Dark overlapping curved back plates form a narrow ridge with pale horn spikes along the upper back and shoulders. Small pale silver-green scaly chest highlight and dark segmented belly, no clothing or armor. Preserve the native small head, long slender limb proportions, narrow waist, claw poses, ivory horns and very dark tonal weight. In casting poses copy only the exact native fire or sparks and their original positions. Green hide changes offline to blue and red; horns, claws, teeth and eye details remain protected. No weapons, wings, added accessories, invented effects, extra limbs or redesign.
